project.name: Timeless Creations Rewards Program (TCRP)
project.description: Full-stack missionary encouragement & rewards dispatch platform with Facebook Messenger bot integration, Brevo 24-month email drips, and ImgBB CDN media gallery.
project.runtime_environment: Node.js (ES Modules / ESM) on Vercel Serverless & Termux (Android arm64)
project.architecture_pattern: Pure JS HTTP micro-endpoints + Static HTML/JS public views

database.driver_protocol: Pure HTTPS JSON pipeline (/v2/pipeline) without native C++ binary dependencies

missionaries.columns: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, email TEXT UNIQUE, points INTEGER DEFAULT 0, referral_code TEXT UNIQUE, fb_sender_id TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

bot_daily_views.columns: sender_id TEXT, view_date TEXT, view_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (sender_id, view_date)
bot_daily_views.rate_limit_policy: Atomic conditional upsert, max 2 views per sender_id per day resetting at 00:00 UTC

cdn_gallery.columns: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, filename TEXT, direct_url TEXT, size_label TEXT, original_kb INTEGER DEFAULT 0, compressed_kb INTEGER DEFAULT 0, delete_url TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

products.columns: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, price INTEGER, image_url TEXT, is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1

actions: upload / upload_cdn_image (ImgBB API upload + SHA-256 encrypted .webp filename + Turso catalog persistence)

api/bot.js.get_handling: Hub challenge verification (hub.verify_token against VERIFY_TOKEN / FB_VERIFY_TOKEN)
api/bot.js.post_handling: Webhook message & postback dispatcher (ACTION_DASHBOARD, ACTION_CATALOG, ACTION_INVITE)

features: Mathematical Unicode bold typography (zero raw asterisks/markdown leaks)
Unicode progress bars for rewards window-shopping (e.g. [■■□□□] 2/5 PTS)
Generic template carousel builder (strictly max 3 buttons per element)

testing_and_verification.test-all.js: Unit test suite covering database execution, bot payload generation, rate limiter, and mailer interfaces
testing_and_verification.test-connections.js: Live ping test verifying Turso DB, Brevo API, ImgBB API, and Meta tokens
testing_and_verification.test-html.js: DOM, meta viewport, and script linkage test across all views and public assets
testing_and_verification.audit-all-endpoints.js: Deep vulnerability and compliance checker for Meta Graph limits and API rate races
